basic_details.job_title: GEU Office Executive Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Graphic Era University Dehradun (GEU) has announced vacancy for the Office Executive post to be based in Dehradun. Eligible applicants can apply by email by submitting their CV with the subject "Application for the post of Office Executive, GEU" latest by 26 October 2026 up to 1700 Hrs. The required qualification for the post includes a Postgraduate degree from a recognized university or institution with at least 60% marks, along with relevant work experience in administration, office management, coordination, or a similar role. The pay is provided as per the University norms.

qualification.details: Postgraduate from a recognized university/institution with at least 60% marks. Strong English communication and interpersonal skills. Good working knowledge of MS Office. Ability to multitask and work effectively within deadlines. | Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience in administration, office management, coordination, or a similar role.

content_sections.heading: About GEU Office Executive
content_sections.text: Graphic Era (Deemed to be) University, Dehradun, operates under its recruitment department to appoint administrative professionals. The institution requires qualified candidates to manage day-to-day office operations, maintain records, and coordinate effectively across multiple academic and administrative departments.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested candidates should submit their CVs to [email protected] . The subject line of the email must be exactly: Application for the post of Office Executive, GEU . Applications must be submitted latest by 26th October 2026 up to 1700 Hrs .

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Postgraduate from a recognized university/institution with at least 60% marks. Strong English communication and interpersonal skills. Good working knowledge of MS Office. Excellent file and document management skills. Strong coordination, organizational, and follow-up abilities. Ability to multitask and work effectively within deadlines. Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience in administration, office management, coordination, or a similar role.

content_sections.heading: GEU Office Executive Job Description
content_sections.text: Manage office files, records, and documentation efficiently. Handle data entry, reports, and MIS using MS Excel. Coordinate with various departments for day-to-day activities. Manage official correspondence, documentation, and follow-ups. Provide administrative support and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks. Maintain confidentiality and accuracy in handling official records.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The official notification does not detail a multi-stage selection process, examination pattern, or interview schedule. Candidates are shortlisted based on their qualifications, experience, and application credentials as evaluated by the university recruitment norms.
